ety.text: Borrowed from German Bank. Ultimately from Proto-Germanic *bankiz (whence ultimately also English bench, Russian банке́тка (bankétka)), further from Proto-Indo-European *bʰeg-. Doublet of ба́нка (bánka). For the bench–bank (банке́тка (bankétka)–банк (bank)) relation, compare typologically ла́вка (lávka), ла́вочник (lávočnik), прила́вок (prilávok).
First attested in 1834 [see citations]. боль (bolʹ) + -е- (-e-) + утоля́ющий (utoljájuščij), calque of German schmerzlindernd [Arapova].
